svg.aria-label: S7 Indirect targets and returns, ITTAGE and the return stack
svg.text: S7 Indirect targets and returns, ITTAGE and the return stack
Indirect targets come from tagged tables that share the path history. Returns come from a 50-entry stack, pushed at a call and popped at a return.
? The table count is not published.
longest table with a tag hit
a target stays until it misses twice
past 50 deep, the stack is cleared
then calls and returns slow sharply
one bubble, repaired by the main stack
the main stack sits at decode
Knowledge base: indpred.kind, indpred.capacity, ras.depth, ras.return_bubble, dirpred.mispredict_penalty, ittage_indirect, two_level_ras, ras_overflow_clear, ras_pac_check
